objects.description: Something sent to chosen groups: a notice, an event or a call for volunteers. Read-only once sent.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: What the post is: a notice to read, an event to attend, or a call for volunteers.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The post's headline.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The post's text.

fields.name: group_ids
fields.description: The groups the post goes to. Opaque ids the host owns.

fields.name: posted_by
fields.description: Who sent the post, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

fields.name: posted_at
fields.description: When the post was sent.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Where the post is in its life; filled applies to a volunteer call only.

fields.name: starts_at
fields.description: When an event starts, or when a volunteer call's help is needed from.

fields.name: ends_at
fields.description: When an event ends, or when a volunteer call's help is needed until; optional for a call.

fields.name: time_zone
fields.description: The IANA time zone an event's day is read in.

fields.name: place
fields.description: Where an event happens, as free text.

fields.name: task
fields.description: What a volunteer call asks people to do.

fields.name: needed_count
fields.description: How many people a volunteer call picks.

indexes.name: posted
indexes.description: The newest-first ordering every listing uses.

objects.description: One person's answer to an event: going or not going. Replaced until the event starts.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: post_id
fields.description: The event answered. The address decides, not the body.

fields.name: participant_id
fields.description: Who answered, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

fields.name: answer
fields.description: The answer given.

fields.name: answered_at
fields.description: When the answer was last given.

indexes.name: once
indexes.description: One answer per person per event.

objects.description: A check-in at an event, by the person themselves or by a holder; unticking keeps the row.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: post_id
fields.description: The event attended.

fields.name: participant_id
fields.description: Who was checked in.

fields.name: checked_in_at
fields.description: When the check-in was last made.

fields.name: checked_in_by
fields.description: Who made the check-in, supplied by the mount: the person themselves or a holder.

fields.name: unticked
fields.description: Whether the check-in was taken back. A later check-in ticks it again.

indexes.name: once
indexes.description: One check-in row per person per event.

objects.description: One person's offer to help with a volunteer call. Withdrawable while the call is open and the offer is not picked.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: post_id
fields.description: The volunteer call offered to.

fields.name: participant_id
fields.description: Who offered, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

fields.name: offered_at
fields.description: When the offer was made.

indexes.name: once
indexes.description: One offer per person per call.

objects.description: An offer the poster chose for a volunteer call.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: post_id
fields.description: The volunteer call the pick is for.

fields.name: offer_id
fields.description: The offer picked.

fields.name: picked_at
fields.description: When the offer was picked.

fields.name: picked_by
fields.description: Who picked it, supplied by the mount.

indexes.name: once
indexes.description: An offer is picked at most once.

objects.description: That one person has read a notice. Its absence is what makes a notice unread.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: post_id
fields.description: The notice read.

fields.name: participant_id
fields.description: Who read it, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

fields.name: read_at
fields.description: When it was first read.

indexes.name: once
indexes.description: One marker per person per notice.
